qa_notes: The panel labeled from east looking west repeats a hero-like view with lantern stalls on the left and the tower vista ahead. A true west-looking view should put the north stalls on the right and reveal the west plaza, as the successful REVERSE WIDE does. The east stair is present but this panel does not establish trustworthy street orientation. Correction: Use PLAN plus HERO/REVERSE as the geographic authority, and derive a later east-end/stair plate from them. Keep the northeast stair relationship when joining LOC20.

The panel labeled from south looking north shows the south shuttered shop row and its billboard. It is a south-wall elevation viewed from the north, rather than the stated camera-side convention. Correction: Relabel this panel SOUTH SHOP ROW / VIEW SOUTH, or otherwise give the actual camera side and bearing.
Strong usable hero, reverse, plan and material references; preserve this market identity. Directional east coverage remains draft and south label needs correction. No automatic retry requested.
Generated sheets are review drafts, not production-approved camera or geometry masters.
Clear empty market, warm lantern stalls, shuttered shops, plaza connection, overhead plan and materials.
